collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — BEYOND THE HORIZON, EVENTS 081 to 130 (draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Fifty more speculative branching events continuing "Isola — Beyond the Horizon" (001-080), in the same format: EVENT nnn — TITLE, SETUP, choices A/B/C, two mutually exclusive outcomes per choice, and an optional "Content note:".

ledger.why: Content note: the owner's per-event content note (the per-event content-notes feature shows it), never part of a page
the owner (2026-11-15): the person the event is about is a cast villager shown by name, the role word kept as flavor (the villager need not have that job)

collection.description: Teaching a child to float, a fisher wonders whether there are people far away who never learn to swim.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: Teaching a child to float, (name1), a fisher, wonders whether there are people far away who never learn to swim.

choices.label: Imagine Them Skilled at Something Else.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: The fisher imagines people who stay far from deep water, and understands, remembering their own first time.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: A child cannot imagine it and asks how anyone could not want to swim.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: An elder suggests they might climb mountains or run great distances instead.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: A scholar says everyone learns what their land requires, and nobody is less for it.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: The child floats for the first time, and the fisher cheers.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: The child would rather wade today, and the fisher says that is fine.
